title: PermissionCatalog
description: Closed, code-owned catalog of global permissions. Each key names a real enforcement point in the GraphQL shield (operation -> permission). Roles (DB data) bundle these keys; a permission has meaning only at its enforcement point, so the catalog is decoupled as DATA but closed in lifecycle (a new key ships with a new gate). Keys are dotted/namespaced (readable, scope-friendly) and therefore exposed over the API as String + catalog-validated, not as a GraphQL enum.

network.statistics.read.description: Read network-wide statistics and pinned-post counts.

role.manage.description: Manage roles and their permissions, and assign/unassign roles to users.

policy.manage.description: View and change network policy settings (defaults, set, reset).

apiKey.administer.description: Administer other users' API keys (list and revoke).

user.email.readAny.description: Read any user's email address (beyond one's own).

user.delete.any.description: Delete any user's account, subject to the act-on hierarchy — you can only delete a user whose permissions are a strict subset of yours (own-account deletion stays self-allowed).

badge.manage.description: Grant and revoke verification and trophy badges.

content.moderate.description: Access reports and review (decide) on reported content.

group.content.read.any_closed.description: Read the content of any CLOSED group without being a member — what a network moderator needs to moderate what they were never shown.

group.content.read.any_hidden.description: Read the content of any HIDDEN group without being a member. Deliberately separate from the closed variant: an unlisted group is the stricter case.

group.moderate.any_closed.description: Moderate inside any CLOSED group without being a member: take a post out of the group. Folds group.post.moderate into the group scope.

group.moderate.any_hidden.description: Moderate inside any HIDDEN group without being a member: take a post out of the group. Folds group.post.moderate into the group scope.

user.disable.description: Disable (deactivate) and re-enable user accounts (reversible), subject to the act-on hierarchy — you can only disable a user whose permissions are a strict subset of yours.

post.create.description: Create posts (still subject to group membership where applicable).

comment.create.description: Comment on posts (still subject to group membership where applicable).

socialMedia.create.description: Add social-media links to one's own profile.

user.invite.description: Generate personal invite codes to invite people to the network.

videoCall.create_open.description: Start (open) a video call in a group a stranger may walk into — one whose non-member role may both find it and join it without approval. Joining an existing call stays a group right.

videoCall.create_restricted.description: Start (open) a video call in a group one cannot simply walk into: joining it needs approval, an invite, or the group is unlisted. The stronger of the two, because such a call cannot be looked in on.

apiKey.create.description: Create personal API keys for backend access (managing/revoking existing keys stays available).

branding.manage.description: View the available baked-in brandings and switch the active branding network-wide.

group.administer.any_public.description: Administer any PUBLIC group as if owning it: settings, roles and member management. The recovery path for a group left without an owner; it may only promote EXISTING members, never the holder themselves.

group.administer.any_closed.description: Administer any CLOSED group as if owning it: settings, roles and member management. The recovery path for a group left without an owner; it may only promote EXISTING members, never the holder themselves.

group.administer.any_hidden.description: Administer any HIDDEN group as if owning it: settings, roles and member management. The recovery path for a group left without an owner; it may only promote EXISTING members, never the holder themselves.

group.roleTemplate.manage.description: View and edit the network-wide group role templates that every new group is seeded from.
